<details>
<summary>≡ƒô¥ Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This change introduces a gamification overhaul featuring a three-tier difficulty mode system (BEGINNER/NORMAL/HARD), replaces single-hint strings with multi-level tiered hints tracked per-step, implements XP costs for hard-mode solution reveals, and adds a new "About Linux" educational page with difficulty and hint UI controls integrated across settings and labs pages.

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Difficulty Mode & XP System** <br> `src/stores/gamificationStore.ts`, `src/config/progression.ts`|Added `difficultyMode` field (BEGINNER/NORMAL/HARD) to gamification state with `setDifficultyMode` setter, new `spendXp(amount)` action for hard-mode solution costs, and `DIFFICULTY_MULTIPLIERS` (1.0/1.5/3.0) + `SOLUTION_COST_HARD_MODE` (200) constants.|
|**Multi-Tier Hint System** <br> `src/components/lab/LabComponents.tsx`, `src/features/lab-engine/types.ts`, `src/stores/labStore.ts`|Replaced single `hint` string with `hints?: string[]` array in `LabStep`, changed `onHintUsed` callback to include hint level parameter, updated hint tracking from `number[]` to `Record<number, number[]>` (per-step hint levels), and refactored hint UI rendering to show tiered LEVEL 1/2/3 blocks with indexed penalties [10, 25, 50].|
|**Hard Mode UX & Solution Gate** <br> `src/components/lab/LabComponents.tsx`|Added `actionText?: string` field to `LabStep`, implemented hard-mode instruction display switching to action-text-only, enforced 200-XP cost on solution reveal in hard mode via `spendXp`, disabled button when XP insufficient, and applied alternate hard-mode styling via `tokens.font.display`.|
|**New About Page & Routing** <br> `src/pages/AboutLinuxPage.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`|Added new lazy-loaded `AboutLinuxPage` component covering Linux Kernel, FHS, Shell, and CLI Philosophy, with back/terminal navigation buttons, and registered `/about` route in App.|
|**Difficulty Mode Integration** <br> `src/pages/LabsPage.tsx`, `src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`, `src/pages/LabView.tsx`|Integrated `useGamificationStore` in LabsPage and SettingsPage to read/set `difficultyMode`, imported `Settings` icon in LabsPage, and updated `LabView.tsx` `handleHintUsed` callback to pass hint level to store tracking.|
|**Testing Updates** <br> `tests/e2e/regression.spec.ts`|Updated Step 5a E2E assertion to match "Step 2" text pattern (case-insensitive) instead of prior broader regex.|
|**Documentation** <br> `requirements.md`|Added functional requirements document for v2.0 gamification overhaul describing difficulty modes, tiered hints, hard-mode costs, and new UI components.|

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant LabComponents
    participant LabStore
    participant GamificationStore
    
    User->>LabComponents: Click "Get Hint"
    LabComponents->>LabStore: Check hintsUsed[stepIndex]
    LabStore-->>LabComponents: Return next hint level
    LabComponents->>GamificationStore: Apply XP penalty<br/>(HINT_PENALTIES[level])
    GamificationStore->>GamificationStore: Deduct XP from balance
    GamificationStore-->>LabComponents: Confirmed
    LabComponents->>LabStore: Record hint usage<br/>(stepIndex, hintLevel)
    LabComponents-->>User: Display hint tier & penalties
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant LabComponents
    participant GamificationStore
    
    User->>LabComponents: Click "Reveal Solution"<br/>(Hard Mode)
    LabComponents->>GamificationStore: Check XP balance
    alt Insufficient XP
        GamificationStore-->>LabComponents: Return false
        LabComponents-->>User: Show alert (need 200 XP)
    else Sufficient XP
        GamificationStore-->>LabComponents: Return true
        LabComponents->>GamificationStore: spendXp(200)
        GamificationStore->>GamificationStore: Deduct 200 XP
        LabComponents-->>User: Reveal solution
    end
```
